description: Xero is a cloud accounting platform with a REST API for invoices, contacts, bank transactions, and accounting data.
access_notes: Developers self-serve sign up for a free Xero account and register an app in the developer portal to get a client id/secret; a free demo company is provided for testing at no cost. Xero's own getting-started FAQ does not describe a separate vendor approval step for basic API access.
api_notes: Invoices, contacts, bank transactions, accounts, items, and payroll/practice-manager APIs.
